summary: The Command flood view and the river-level chart are built. M1: the hydrograph (pure model with productsAt re-exported, NWS flood levels with bands and pinned labels, observed/forecast split, NWM on the flow axis only and never without a reach_id, flow-mode handle with NWS and NWM on separate lines, LATEST stale after 3 h, crest or HIGH AT END, product ticks, DST-safe day ticks, metric, empty states; slim and dock components with a keyboard slider and no play button). M2: CommandFloodChrome with Command fire's layout (bar with the primary gauge line, FloodReadout, Official now column and phone sheet, legend chips, slim chart), FloodReadout (tagged per-layer lines at the chart's handle, nearest gauge on the flood's rivers, category words, crest or forecast high, NO_GAUGE_NEAR only for available answers, flood rows, area figures with caveats). M3: Command-only map layers (NWS category flood map hatch, NWM flooded area and high-flow reaches in amber dotted with MODEL · EXPERIMENTAL labels), state/floodLayerData.ts, the Layers drawer's high-flow toggle and CatFIM target, gauge list from the bar and the chart, one reading per gauge (the newest of list, flood answer and the chart's series), past floods (chart at the last NWS product, PAST_NO_FORECAST), phones. Fire Command view unchanged.

known_issues: The readout is long at 1440x1000: with a selected point its last gauge row (forecast crest) and the flood rows scroll below the fold (the card fades and scrolls, like the fire readout).
The readout's lines describe every answered layer at the point even when that layer is hidden in Layers (the same as Public's point card).

The model's MODEL · EXPERIMENTAL label is placed along polygon edges only where they are straight enough (symbol-placement line); the dotted amber edge, the readout tag and the legend chip always say it.

NWPS's status reading can lag its own series by hours (AGYM7 on 2026-11-05: 3 h). Command shows the newest of the list's, the flood answer's and the chart's series reading everywhere; the series reading's category is NWS's levels compared with the stage.

Past floods: the real API lists none yet (backend-flood-live M2) and answers GAUGES_PAST_NOT_YET for past gauge readings; the chart then shows the backend's reason. The past screenshot uses the fixture server.
The fixture server answers every demo flood's evacuations with the New Mexico fixture (pre-existing), so the past Kentucky demo shows 'Not available in this state · New Mexico'.
On a narrow chart the crest label is left out when it cannot sit beside the NOW label; its caret keeps the tooltip and the readout and Official now give the crest.
The Official now column has no 'View all updates' and no data-status block (there is no flood updates feed).
cut_line_left: Small multiples in the dock variant (Forensic shows one gauge at a time, with the GaugeList export available for a picker).
cut_line_done: Metric units in the hydrograph tooltip: the handle's title gives the value in the original units.
